steps: Open a new C&N consumer checking account (Everyday, Relationship, or Merit) with promo code 4SUITS.
Deposit $25 or more in new money to C&N within the first 7 business days from the account opening date.

For Tier One ($300): make 12 qualifying transactions on the checking account each month for the first 6 consecutive months (the 6-month clock starts the first day of the month after opening), OR receive 3 months of consecutive direct deposits totaling $1,000+ within the first 6 months.

For Tier Two (another $300, $600 total): meet all Tier One requirements AND open a Key Savings Account, Consumer Super Money Fund, or CD with $10,000+ in new money within 14 days of opening the checking account (using promo code 4SUITS), OR open a C&N Home Equity Line&Lock with a $20,000+ draw within 6 months of opening the checking account.
Keep all accounts open for 6 months from the opening date.
The bonus is paid within 45 days of the 6-month anniversary of the checking account opening (payout valid through August 15, 2027).
